annotations.title: Where Will the 11/64 EMA Cross? — SML PRECROSS

description: SML PRECROSS (PAID $0.02 USDC on Base via x402). 11/64 EMA cross intelligence for US stocks and ETFs on 1H or 4H (regular session) or 1D bars — derived analysis, not raw bars. Returns the exact price at which the 11 and 64 EMA cross on the next bar (closed-form, plus a zero-lag variant), the move needed to reach it in % and ATR, whether the EMAs are converging and an estimated bars-to-cross, and a walk-forward self-backtest of anticipating that cross (in-sample config selection, out-of-sample verdict, costs both sides, confirmed-cross baseline for comparison) with a six-check proof gate per side; on 1H/4H the grid also tests a "daily agrees" filter (daily 11/64 trend, no lookahead). Also returns a 75-ticker basket proof (pooled out-of-sample trades across US stocks and funds incl. gold, silver, Bitcoin and Ethereum funds, with breadth check and standout ranking) and a plain-English summary. A long/short setup is returned ONLY for a side whose out-of-sample results pass the gate (this ticker's own gate, or the basket gate when the ticker is in the basket); otherwise the direction is withheld and the reason is given. Use for: knowing where an 11/64 EMA cross will trigger before it prints, and whether anticipating it has actually worked on this ticker and timeframe. Don't use when: you need raw OHLC bars, timeframes below 1H, spot crypto, or order execution (this tool places no orders). Research output, not financial advice.
